summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Brazil's CVM partially approved its request to discontinue its Sponsored Level II Brazilian Depositary Receipts (BDR) program. Holders may elect to receive underlying NASDAQ-traded Class A shares (INTR) or unsponsored Level I BDRs (INBR34) on a 1:1 basis; those not electing will use a Sales Facility to sell underlying shares and receive proceeds. The company will provide a detailed schedule within ten Brazilian business days. Watch for election-period mechanics and potential arbitrage between BDR and INTR pricing.
